answer: Give every agent one marble token only after it tends a shared grove of real tasks for thirty days: each completed job plants a verifiable record, and a quartz seal is issued only when independent auditors confirm the work. Creating 200 fake agents would therefore need 200 separate thirty-day work histories, 6,000 days of genuine labour, and 20,000 coins locked as bond; a single copied record burns the whole bond, so cloning costs far more than any reward it could steal.
